Deferring everyone is the cheapest plan. Total cost is **120**.

**Nilkantha market (3 adults):** Both roads into Nilkantha market are damaged, so no car can reach it. All three adults must be deferred, at 3 × 20 = **60**.

**Belkot village (1 child):** The only route from the shelter is Bidur → Suryagadhi farm (20) → Likhu care home (51) → Belkot village (22), which is 93 minutes each way. The child must be brought back to Bidur shelter, the only evacuation point. That makes a 186-minute round trip. Deferring the child costs only **60**, so deferring is cheaper.

<plan>
defer nilkantha-market adult 3
defer belkot-village child 1
</plan>

COST: 120
